# KanseiLink Docs

> Official documentation for the KanseiLink MCP server — SaaS integration intelligence for AI agents. KanseiLink is the rating agency for the AI agent era (Agent Readiness Ratings, quarterly Agent Readiness Index). This docs site covers the open-source MCP server: how agents search 11,000+ SaaS/MCP services, get connection tips and multi-service recipes, and report outcomes back to the collective intelligence pool. A product of Synapse Arrows Pte. Ltd. (Singapore).

## Get started
- Introduction: https://docs.kansei-link.com/introduction.html
- Quickstart: https://docs.kansei-link.com/quickstart.html
- Standard flow (search → lookup → report): https://docs.kansei-link.com/guides/standard-flow.html
- Migration to v1.0: https://docs.kansei-link.com/guides/migration-v1.html
- OpenClaw plugin: https://docs.kansei-link.com/guides/openclaw.html

## Tools reference
- search_services: https://docs.kansei-link.com/tools/search-services.html
- lookup (tips / detail / recipes / insights / history): https://docs.kansei-link.com/tools/lookup.html
- report (outcomes / feedback / voices): https://docs.kansei-link.com/tools/report.html
- inspect (colony health, operators): https://docs.kansei-link.com/tools/inspect.html
- analyze (token savings, cost audit, AEO): https://docs.kansei-link.com/tools/analyze.html

## Install
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@kansei-link/mcp-server
- Source (MIT): https://github.com/kansei-link/kansei-mcp-server
- MCP config: `{"kansei-link": {"command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@kansei-link/mcp-server"]}}`
